## Preprints

### Habilis Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery

Tommoro Robotics (2026)\
[arXiv:2609.25558](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25558)

A vision–language–action (VLA) model trained to predict how the scene's geometry will change, so that its visual interface can be pretrained on robot and egocentric video before being aligned to a specific robot's actions. A separate residual policy, learned from closed-loop feedback, then corrects the frozen model's actions.

### Habilis-β: A Fast-Motion and Long-Lasting On-Device Vision-Language-Action Model

Tommoro Robotics (2026)\
[arXiv:2602.18813](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18813)

An on-device vision–language–action (VLA) model for fast-motion, long-duration real-world robot deployment. In 1-hour continuous-run evaluations it achieves strong performance under the PRP metrics, compared with π₀.₅ in both simulation and the real world.

## Theses

### Ionospheric Outflow: From Fundamental Theory to Modern Modeling Frameworks

Kimm, S. M. (2025). *M.S. Thesis, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign* (Advisor: Raluca Ilie).\
[IDEALS](https://hdl.handle.net/2142/129196)

A survey of plasma exchange between Earth and space, that is, how charged particles escape from the ionosphere. It covers theoretical foundations, modeling approaches from classical to contemporary frameworks, and mechanisms such as ambipolar electric fields and wave–particle interactions.
